basic_details.job_title: DHS Ariyalur Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 13 Posts
basic_details.short_information: The District Health Society, Ariyalur District (மாவட்ட நலவாழ்வு சங்கம், அரியலூர் மாவட்டம்) has invited applications for 13 Staff Nurse posts on a purely temporary contract basis at the CEMoNC centres (including SNCU and PICU) of the Government District Hospital, Jayankondam. Applications must be submitted in person or by post to the Secretary / District Health Officer at the District Health Office, Ariyalur, and must reach by 5.00 PM on 04 December 2026. Applications are invited from 21 November 2026.

Nursing Diploma (GNM) or B.Sc. Nursing; Tamil Nadu Nursing Council registration mandatory
Government District Hospital, Jayankondam, Ariyalur District

content_sections.heading: About the Recruitment
content_sections.text: The notice is a press release of the District Health Society, Ariyalur District, under the Health and Family Welfare Department. The 13 contract Staff Nurse posts are newly created under the National Health Mission scheme for the Comprehensive Emergency Obstetric and Newborn Care (CEMoNC) centres, including SNCU and PICU, functioning at the Government District Hospital, Jayankondam, Ariyalur District.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send or hand in the completed application, with copies of the relevant certificates, to the following address: Secretary / District Health Officer, District Health Society, District Health Office, Government Multi-Department Office Complex, Jayankondam Road, Ariyalur - 621704 The application can be submitted in person or by post. It must be submitted by 5.00 PM on 04.12.2026. The application forms, and the district-wise and institution-wise vacancy details, can be downloaded from nhm.tn.gov.in and ariyalur.nic.in. The notice does not print a subject line or an envelope superscription.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice lists one post, Staff Nurse on contract basis, with 13 vacancies and a pay of Rs.21000 per month. The notice does not print category-wise vacancies. Qualification: Nursing Diploma (GNM) or B.Sc. Nursing from a government or government-recognised private nursing college, recognised by the State Government. Registration: Tamil Nadu Nursing Council registration is mandatory. Age limit: up to 50 years, counted as on the date of issue of the notice letter. Pay: Rs.21000 per month, as printed ("மாதம் ஒன்றுக்கு"). The notice mentions no age relaxation and no experience requirement.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Copies of the relevant certificates, enclosed with the completed application. Caste certificate. Education certificate. Residence certificate.

content_sections.text: Applications without the certificates, or without the relevant caste, education and residence certificates, are treated as ineligible and rejected. The posts are purely temporary and on contract basis. Selected persons have no right to claim a permanent appointment. Selected persons are appointed as per Government Order No. 427, Health and Family Welfare Department, dated 18.11.2026. The number of vacancies is subject to change.

faq.question: Q1. How many Staff Nurse vacancies are there at Ariyalur District Health Society?
faq.answer: There are 13 Staff Nurse vacancies on contract basis. The notice says the number of vacancies is subject to change.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must reach the District Health Office, Ariyalur by 5.00 PM on 04 December 2026. Applications are invited from 21 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the Staff Nurse posts?
faq.answer: A Nursing Diploma (GNM) or B.Sc. Nursing from a government or government-recognised private nursing college, recognised by the State Government. Tamil Nadu Nursing Council registration is mandatory.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is up to 50 years, counted as on the date of issue of the notice letter.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the Staff Nurse?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs.21000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply?
faq.answer: Submit the completed application with copies of certificates, in person or by post, to the Secretary / District Health Officer, District Health Society, District Health Office, Ariyalur. The form can be downloaded from nhm.tn.gov.in and ariyalur.nic.in.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The posts are purely temporary and on contract basis, and selected persons cannot claim permanent appointment.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the Staff Nurses work?
faq.answer: The posts are at the CEMoNC centres, including SNCU and PICU, of the Government District Hospital, Jayankondam, Ariyalur District.

faq.question: Q9. When will an application be rejected?
faq.answer: An application is rejected as ineligible if the certificates are not enclosed, or if the caste, education or residence certificate is missing.
